source_text: {In order that the DOF specifications \eqref{eq:complete-form-degrees-of-freedom} and \eqref{eq:trimmed-form-degrees-of-freedom} well define finite element spaces, we must verify \emph{unisolvence} for each of them. This requires showing, first, that the total number of DOFs we have associated to the shape function space is no more than its dimension and, second, that if all the DOFs vanish for some $\omega$ in the shape function space, then $\omega$ itself vanishes. This can be accomplished for both choices of shape function spaces. Here we verify unisolvence for the trimmed space $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(T)$, for any polynomial degree $r\geq1$, any dimension $n\geq1$, and any form degree $0\leq k\leq n$. The proof, which is based on the properties of the Koszul differential, is taken directly from \BookCite{6}. A very similar proof applies in the case of the complete polynomial spaces.}
translated_text: {为使自由度规定 \eqref{eq:complete-form-degrees-of-freedom} 和 \eqref{eq:trimmed-form-degrees-of-freedom} 良好地定义有限元空间, 必须分别验证其\emph{唯一可解性}. 这需要证明: 首先, 关联于形函数空间的自由度总数不超过空间维数; 其次, 若形函数空间中某个 $\omega$ 的所有自由度都为零, 则 $\omega$ 本身为零. 对两种形函数空间都可以做到这一点. 这里对任意多项式次数 $r\geq1$, 任意维数 $n\geq1$ 和任意形式次数 $0\leq k\leq n$, 验证修剪空间 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(T)$ 的唯一可解性. 证明基于 Koszul 微分的性质, 直接取自 \BookCite{6}. 完全多项式空间的情形有十分相似的证明.}

source_text: {Thus we have defined a family of spaces of polynomial differential $k$-forms on each element $T$ for use as shape functions, namely, the spaces $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(T)$ and $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(T)$, defined for each $r\geq1$. Moreover, for each of these spaces we have specified a unisolvent set of DOFs. Together with the triangulation $\mathcal T_h$, each such choice then determines a corresponding finite element space $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ or $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ of piecewise polynomial differential forms.}
translated_text: {由此在每个单元 $T$ 上定义了一族用作形函数的多项式微分 $k$-形式空间, 即对每个 $r\geq1$ 定义的空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(T)$ 和 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(T)$. 此外, 对每个空间都指定了一组具有唯一可解性的自由度. 结合剖分 $\mathcal T_h$, 每一种这样的选择都确定相应的分片多项式微分形式有限元空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ 或 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$.}

source_text: {The commutativity of the canonical projections with the exterior derivative can be verified using the Stokes theorem. It is a crucial property: the main step toward the construction of bounded cochain projections.}
translated_text: {典范投影与外微分的交换性, 可用 Stokes 定理验证. 这是一个关键性质: 它是构造有界上链投影的主要步骤.}
